about.title: Behind every product — a family hand full of love
about.body: OSR was born from a deep belief that the creativity of productive families deserves a platform worthy of it — one that showcases authentic homemade cooking, carefully crafted handmade items, and exceptional products. We are here to make the selling journey simple, beautiful, and profitable for every family that pours their heart into their work.

partners.title: Powering productive families in every city

items.a: Yes! Any family that produces food, handcrafts, or home products can register and create their store in minutes.

items.q: What categories are available on the platform?
items.a: Three main categories: Food & Sweets, Crafts & Handwork, and Products. Within each category you can sell ready-made, on-demand, or for special occasions.

items.q: How does the product reach the customer?
items.a: Through OSR's network of available delivery agents in your city, or you can set a direct pickup option if you prefer.

items.q: When do I receive my earnings?
items.a: Earnings are transferred regularly and systematically directly to your bank account.

items.q: Is the platform secure for payments?
items.a: Yes, all payment operations are fully secured with trusted and certified local payment options.
